name: bge-reranker-v2-m3-italian
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: cross-encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full bidirectional attention over query+passage
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-13. CAVEAT: evaluated on 2,000 translated MS MARCO queries - the training distribution - and the win over the base reranker is +0.01 nDCG@10 (the card's own CI [+0.005, +0.015]); the larger +0.034 belongs to adding any reranker at all. Both reranker rows share the same first-stage retriever.

benchmarks.name: nDCG@10 (2k Italian queries, mMARCO)
benchmarks.config: Card table pipeline rows: '+ BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3' 0.821 vs '+ bge-reranker-v2-m3-italian' 0.830. +0.0096 over the base reranker, CI [+0.005, +0.015], p < 0.0001; same first-stage retriever.
